scope: POSIX/SysV bindings on the playground 64-bit Linux/glibc environment. The source library is unchanged. The manifest features/profiles tables are removed for FPM 0.12 compatibility and their Linux preprocessor flag is supplied explicitly. A 13-byte sandbox-local file is created, its size is checked through c_stat, then c_unlink removes it and Fortran INQUIRE confirms removal. Other operating systems, process creation, networking, IPC, signals, threads and all ABI structures are not validated or promised in the restricted sandbox.
